description: A Minecraft Java Edition mod that fixes the shipwreck and beached shipwreck generation and placement

mods.name: Corrected Shipwrecks
mods.description: This is an example description! Tell everyone what your mod is about!

releases.notes:
Fixes:

1. Fixes placement and generation of shipwrecks on packed icesheets in frozen ocean biomes (no more floating ships).
2. Fixes carving of ship shapes on said ice sheets.
3. Fixes generation of beached shipwrecks (basically relying on vanilla placement) with a few enhancements such as ignoring flora so that they look 'old' and more realistic with flora growing on the ships.
4. Fixes generation of shipwrecks so that they are 'always' resting on the ocean floor instead of a few blocks above etc..   they also ignore flora and can be covered in seagrass etc..

Requires Minecraft 26.2 minimum, Java 25 minimum, latest Fabric and Fabric API.
